pages.title: US strikes on Iranian nuclear sites and Iran–Israel ceasefire

facts.text: Targets: Natanz, Fordow, Isfahan — US joined the Israel–Iran conflict (reignited June 2025)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Trump had given Iran "two weeks" to negotiate; Iran recently censured by IAEA
facts.head: News

facts.text: Site: Natanz; Detail: ~220 km SE of Tehran; main enrichment site; up to 60% enrichment; partly underground; Weapon: Tomahawk + bunker busters
facts.head: News

facts.text: Site: Fordow; Detail: under a mountain near Qom, ~100 km SW of Tehran; exposed 2009; Weapon: 12 GBU-57 MOPs from six B-2 bombers
facts.head: News

facts.text: Site: Isfahan; Detail: ~350 km SE of Tehran; three Chinese-built research reactors; Weapon: Tomahawk
facts.head: News

facts.text: GBU-57 MOP: 30,000-pound conventional bunker buster
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ Fordow is underground; Natanz (not Fordow) is the main enrichment centre
facts.head: News

facts.text: Iran FM Abbas Araghchi: "grave violation" of UN Charter and NPT
facts.head: Reactions

facts.text: Israel PM Netanyahu: "historic"
facts.head: Reactions

facts.text: Iran and NPT: signed 1968, ratified 1970
facts.head: Reactions

facts.text: Law: UN Charter Article 2 — bars use of force; Strait of Hormuz oil risk
facts.head: Reactions

facts.text: Strike: Iran hit the US Al-Udeid Air Base, Qatar (heart of CENTCOM) a day after US strikes — with advance notice, no casualties
facts.head: Iran's retaliation and ceasefire

facts.text: Ceasefire: Trump announced a "Complete and Total Ceasefire" between Iran and Israel
facts.head: Iran's retaliation and ceasefire

facts.text: Israel's campaign: 11 days — IRGC HQ, air defences, leadership
facts.head: Iran's retaliation and ceasefire

facts.text: Iran's missile: solid-fuel Kheybar Shekan
facts.head: Iran's retaliation and ceasefire

facts.text: Restraint: no blockade of Strait of Hormuz; proxies stayed silent
facts.head: Iran's retaliation and ceasefire

facts.text: Proxy: Houthis; Country: Yemen
facts.head: Iran's retaliation and ceasefire

facts.text: Proxy: Hezbollah; Country: Lebanon — leader Hassan Nasrallah killed 2024; now Naim Qassem
facts.head: Iran's retaliation and ceasefire

facts.text: Proxy: Hashd al-Shaabi (Popular Mobilization Forces); Country: Iraq
facts.head: Iran's retaliation and ceasefire

facts.text: India stakes: Strait of Hormuz ~40% of India's oil imports; 8 million+ Indians in West Asia
facts.head: Iran's retaliation and ceasefire

facts.text: Arab nuclear plans: UAE runs a nuclear power plant; Saudi Arabia fast-tracking
facts.head: Iran's retaliation and ceasefire

facts.text: Conflict length: ceasefire after 12 days (⚠ one source counts Israel's strikes over 11 days)
facts.head: Nuclear order concerns

facts.text: Iran: NPT signatory; accepted inspections under JCPOA (2015, with P5+1 — US, UK, France, Russia, China + Germany)
facts.head: Nuclear order concerns

facts.text: Iran parliament: debating a bill to exit NPT — ⚠ no formal withdrawal yet (June 2025)
facts.head: Nuclear order concerns

facts.text: Israel: ⚠ not an NPT signatory; undeclared arsenal, no IAEA inspections
facts.head: Nuclear order concerns

facts.text: Related treaty: TPNW (Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons)
facts.head: Nuclear order concerns

facts.text: Meeting: 9th Joint Defence Committee (JDC), Johannesburg (⚠ not Cape Town), 24–25 June 2025
facts.head: News

facts.text: Signed: two agreements on submarine cooperation
facts.head: News

facts.text: Leaders: India — Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh; South Africa — Acting Secretary for Defence Dr Thobekile Gamede
facts.head: News

facts.text: Sub-committees: Defence Policy & Military Cooperation; Defence Acquisition, Production, R&D
facts.head: News

facts.text: Shared groupings: BRICS, IORA, IBSA, NAM
facts.head: News
